recorded_by: human manual review (reported to the agent)
human_note: Round 4 proved that every rendered phrase has concern-owned provenance, but provenance consistency is not semantic validation. The reviewer found rows that are fully traceable and still wrong: a quality requirement carrying the delivery location, 95% described as the retention ratio, a performance bond citing the response bond, an unsupported 报价无漏项 assertion, and a payment row absorbing the agency fee. None of those could be caught by a mechanism that only checks the row against its own generated metadata.
required_invariant: PROVENANCE CONSISTENCY IS NOT SEMANTIC VALIDATION

mechanism: ConcernContract: one hand-authored semantic contract per concern, authored from the human fixture brief and never derived from the generated ReviewPoint

each contract declares its allowed actors, authority scopes, required/forbidden lexical-source signatures, allowed/forbidden numeric roles, allowed linked fact keys, material classes, consequence classes, scoring roles, required evidence properties and kind

validate_point audits the FINAL rendered cell text (displayed requirement, review checks, pass criteria, materials, consequence, scoring guidance, numeric roles, linked facts, evidence) against that contract
the segment reader keeps only the contract-owned segments of a mixed clause, so a row cannot inherit a neighbour's facet
fixtures A..T from the human review are encoded as executable tests with hand-written expected roles

resolved_findings: QUALITY_LOCATION_CONTAMINATION = 0: the quality row no longer displays 周口市郸城县石槽泵站
PAYMENT_RATIO_95_AS_RETENTION = false: 95% is the payment ratio and 5% the retention money
PERFORMANCE_BOND_RESPONSE_BOND_EVIDENCE = 0: 履约保证金 evidence is never a response-bond clause
UNSUPPORTED_PRICE_COMPLETENESS_ASSERTIONS = 0: no 报价无漏项/无重复项 claim without a source clause
PRICE_ACCEPTANCE_MIXED_CONCERNS = 0 and TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE_MIXED_CONCERNS = 0: the split facets stay in their own rows
CONTRACT_PAYMENT_FOREIGN_CLAUSE = 0: the contract payment row carries neither the agency fee nor an effectivity clause
FALSE_PLATFORM_CONFLICTS = 0: the platform roles are split without inventing a conflict
CASE001_FIXTURES_A_TO_T = 20/20 PASS and CASE001_FINAL_WORKBOOK_AUDIT = ALL/ALL coherent
still_open_for_the_human: CASE001_XLSX_MANUAL_REVIEW remains unconfirmed; automation never ticks a human box
